rule: Station-stratified structural shortlist of 30 eligible tasks per split (6 per eval station, 3 per train station), ordered by descending source count, near-binding draft standards (total/limit >= 0.8), uncontrolled-at-GEP upper-bound exceedance, then task ID. Probe draft, cheapest_first_greedy, v1_coordinate_descent, 60-second search, and random_30 with seeds 0..7 using ARM2 fast fields. Failed policies contribute zero savings. Hardness = 1 - greedy_saved/best_saved (zero if best_saved is zero); best includes every probe. Variance proxy is population standard deviation of the eight random saved fractions. Rank hard candidates by the product of within-split midrank percentiles of hardness and variance (then hardness, variance, ID). Reserve two easiest candidates from distinct stations first; fill eight hard slots subject to 2 tasks per eval station / 1 per train station. No model outcomes or pilot membership enter selection.
structure_note: Manifest has no binding/exceedance metadata; native ARM2 draft records supply near-binding counts and a uniform-control uncontrolled-at-GEP bound (NO2 ratio bound .9/.5).
selection_reproducibility: Selection is deterministic from frozen probe artifacts. A fresh wall-time-bounded search can visit a different number of nodes on a different host.
